blocks.html: 6.1  Authorization and Capture
blocks.text: 6.1  Authorization and Capture

blocks.html: When you place an order, your payment method is authorized at the time of checkout. This authorization is a temporary hold on your funds and does not constitute a completed charge. Full payment capture occurs when your order is confirmed and fulfilled for shipment. If your order is cancelled before fulfillment, any authorization hold will be released according to your financial institution’s standard processing times (typically 3–7 business days). (Mont. Code Ann. § 30-3-414 — Obligation of Drawer; Mont. Code Ann. § 30-18-101 — Electronic Transactions)

blocks.html: SECTION 7 – FRAUD PROTECTION & ORDER VERIFICATION
blocks.text: SECTION 7 – FRAUD PROTECTION & ORDER VERIFICATION

blocks.html: MT Elk Inc. takes fraud seriously to protect both our customers and our business.
blocks.text: MT Elk Inc. takes fraud seriously to protect both our customers and our business.

blocks.html: FRAUD NOTICE:  MT Elk Inc. employs automated and manual fraud detection on all orders. Orders that trigger fraud indicators may be cancelled, held for verification, or reported to law enforcement. Attempting to use fraudulent payment information is a criminal offense under Montana and federal law.

blocks.html: 7.1  Automated Fraud Screening
blocks.text: 7.1  Automated Fraud Screening

blocks.html: All orders are subject to automated fraud screening through our payment processor and order management systems. Fraud screening evaluates factors including, but not limited to: billing and shipping address mismatch, unusual order patterns, high-risk IP addresses, and velocity checks (multiple orders in a short time period). MT Elk Inc. reserves the right to cancel any order that fails our fraud screening criteria without prior notice. (Mont. Code Ann. § 30-14-1703 — Data Security and Fraud Prevention)

blocks.html: 7.2  Order Verification Holds
blocks.text: 7.2  Order Verification Holds

blocks.html: If your order is flagged for manual review, MT Elk Inc. may:
blocks.text: If your order is flagged for manual review, MT Elk Inc. may:

blocks.html:
• Contact you via the email address or phone number on file to verify your identity and order details.
  • Request additional documentation, such as a copy of a government-issued ID or the card used for purchase.
  • Place your order on hold for up to 3 business days pending verification.
  • Cancel the order if verification cannot be completed within the hold period.

blocks.html: 8.4  Structuring Prohibition
blocks.text: 8.4  Structuring Prohibition

blocks.html: STRUCTURING WARNING:  It is a federal crime to deliberately break up a transaction into smaller amounts to avoid reporting thresholds or MT Elk Inc.’s large-order verification requirements. This practice, known as “structuring,” is prohibited under federal law regardless of whether the underlying funds are from a legitimate source. MT Elk Inc. monitors for structuring patterns across multiple orders and will report suspected structuring activity to federal authorities.
blocks.text: STRUCTURING WARNING:  It is a federal crime to deliberately break up a transaction into smaller amounts to avoid reporting thresholds or MT Elk Inc.’s large-order verification requirements. This practice, known as “structuring,” is prohibited under federal law regardless of whether the underlying funds are from a legitimate source. MT Elk Inc. monitors for structuring patterns across multiple orders and will report suspected structuring activity to federal authorities.

blocks.html: MT Elk Inc. reserves the right to refuse, cancel, or refund any large order at its sole discretion, including where: (a) verification requirements cannot be met; (b) the transaction is flagged by our payment processor or banking partner; (c) the order exhibits indicators of fraud, structuring, or money laundering; or (d) fulfillment of the order would place MT Elk Inc. in violation of applicable banking or financial regulations.
